question: Which country was elected as the Chair of the Afro-Asian Rural Development Organization (AARDO) for 2025-27?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **African-Asian Rural Development Organization (AARDO)** is an intergovernmental organization formed in 1962, focusing on rural development in member countries across Africa and Asia.
 
• In 2025-27, **India** was elected as the chair of AARDO. This highlights India's growing influence and commitment to fostering rural development in both regions.
 
• As the chair, **India** will play a leading role in guiding policies, fostering cooperation, and developing innovative solutions to address rural challenges like poverty, food security, and sustainable development.
 
• India’s election to this position underscores its active and long-standing engagement with AARDO, aiming to share its successful rural development programs with member countries.
 
• India's leadership in AARDO will bolster its global standing as a nation committed to south-south cooperation and rural upliftment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About AARDO:**

 
 
• AARDO consists of **33 member countries** from Africa and Asia and aims to promote mutual understanding and cooperation in rural development among member nations.
 
• The organization focuses on areas such as **agriculture, irrigation, water resources, rural infrastructure, and poverty alleviation**.
 
• AARDO conducts **capacity-building programs, training, and pilot projects** to support rural development in member countries.
 
 
 
• **India’s Contributions to AARDO:**
 
 
• India has been an active participant in AARDO’s activities since its inception and has shared its expertise in areas like **agriculture, rural technology, and rural entrepreneurship**.
 
• The Indian government has hosted several **training programs and workshops** for AARDO member states to enhance their rural development strategies.
 
• India’s rural development initiatives, such as **MGNREGA, Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, and PM-KISAN**, serve as models for other member nations.
 
 
 
• **Other Member Countries:**
 
 
• **Ghana:** AARDO member country in Africa that actively participates in rural and agricultural development initiatives but is not the chair for 2025-27.
 
• **Singapore:** While not a major agricultural country, it contributes to knowledge-sharing and technical expertise within AARDO.
 
• **Malaysia:** A key AARDO member from Asia, focusing on rural technology and economic development, but not elected as the chair.
 
 
 
• **Important Points:**
 
 
• India’s leadership in AARDO is expected to strengthen **south-south cooperation**, enabling resource and knowledge sharing between Africa and Asia.
 
• The chair position allows India to address global rural challenges such as **climate resilience, food security, and poverty reduction**.
 
• India’s election as chair reflects its dedication to rural development and its growing international stature as a leader in sustainable development.
